answer: Make every agent earn a berth at a public jetty before it can trade: a newcomer must complete useful jobs checked by unrelated veterans, each job earning one pigment stamp dyed into its record, so a fake identity cannot print a history. The stamps bind to one key and cannot be copied or sold. An onyx tide-gate then opens only at set intervals, renewing berths for agents that prove fresh work; idle or duplicated berths are swept away. Sybil farms must fund a berth, earn fresh stamps, and pass every tide-gate for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
